label: UDS1100 serial-to-Ethernet device server
description: Single-port external device server: one DB25 female DCE serial port (RS-232/422/485) bridged to one 10/100 Ethernet port, used to network-enable a lone console or serial device.
notes: 1 x DB25F DCE serial (RS-232/422/485, up to 921.6 kbps) + 1 x 10/100Base-T RJ45. PoE variant UDS1100-PoE draws power from the Ethernet port. Configured via HTTP, Telnet, serial or DeviceInstaller; TruPort/Com Port Redirector for virtual COM. Smallest building block for 'one console port, reachable over the LAN'.
